title: The Wrong Harvest
author: Gideon Eastwick
blurb: Wendell Coldharbour, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, has spent fifteen years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
